'''Lioness''' was a horse ridden by [[Elayne Trakand]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lioness}}

==Activities==
Lioness carried Elayne from the [[Wise Woman]]'s farm near Ebou Dar, through a [[Traveling|gateway]] into [[Andor]].{{ref/book|8|2}}{{ref/book|8|3}} When Elayne picks apart her weave for the gateway, it explodes, killing Lioness.{{ref/book|8|6}}
